citations.claim: emergency active during EW yellow, disrupting cycle
NS green just before failing yellow
NS yellow starts, short cycle begins
first violation step: NS should still be yellow but turned red after only 4s

counterfactual.change: Removed single emergency event (events=[]), keeping all other fields identical; this restores full 6s yellow and eliminates violation

explanation: Emergency at t=31 during EW yellow corrupts internal phase timer. Controller preempts to NS but does not reset yellow timer correctly, so final NS yellow from step 104 to 107 lasts only 4 seconds instead of required 6 before all-red at step 108, violating yellow_duration. Removing emergency restores correct timing.
vision_note: Steps 105, 106 and 107 show two approaches with yellow signals while the other two are red. At step 108 all four signals become red after only 3 seconds of yellow, visibly truncating the yellow phase before the all-red clearance.
